scripts.text:
[Ridsh]
Oh?
What are you doing here?

[Ridsh]
We're in trouble~~
We can't have anyone know we're here~~

[Dien]
The adventurer is here too!
Why are you scared!

[Dien]
Hello {0}.
We've came here to do something... It was too troublesome to tell the youngsters.

[Dien]
If you keep it a secret that you saw us...

[Ridsh]
Sister~~
What are you talking about, I don't see the adventurer!

[Cotnes]
Oh~
Yeah?
I don't see the adventurer either~

[Cotnes]
So what now?
We're already inside.

[Ridsh]
It can't be helped~~
We have to go with the adventurer.

[Dien]
It's dangerous, so please come with us.
- There is a pipe going through the floor. -
Crush it.
Put it down.
- Nothing happened. -
- The machine stopped with a strange noise when the pipe was broken. -

[Dien]
Oh my! What's that thing in the front?

[Dien]
Oh my! I think it's precise device that's placed here in the abandoned mine.

[Dien]
If you don't break the machine on the other side, we will not be able pass it!

[Dien]
It's dangerous to go through right now, so let's turn around and go where the device is!

[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.

[Cotnes]
Oh, is this gate too hard?
It will take some time to break it~

[Dien]
Oh!
If you go to the right, I think you can go back on the railroad without having to break the door.

[Ridsh]
Argh!

[Est]
Oh...
I'm in a hurry, what are you doing here?

[Est]
Please go back and enjoy your tea gracefully.

[Ridsh]
Huh!
How did you sneak in here anyway?

[Est]
This is only a surveillance routine.
If you close your eyes for a second, you may run into an accident.

[Ridsh]
What makes you think we need your help?

[Est]
Didn't you just did now?
I don't think I heard that wrong. Did I?

[Cotnes]
You two really~
Please stop fighting.

[Dien]
How do you always fight like that?

[Cotnes]
I'm so excited about this~ I'm getting old and I'm tired of fighting.

[Dien]
Is that so?

[Cotnes]
Yeah~
I'm tired of fighting, let's go back to work.
The road is open now.

[Dien]
Finally..
If you cross this door...

[Est]
Let's head back now before they gather more troops.

[Dien]
Excuse me.

[Est]
?

[Ridsh]
Why?

[Dien]
Oh my, oh my!
What should we do!

[Ridsh]
Why, what's going on?

[Dien]
I think I've left it.

[Ridsh]
Left what?

[Dien]
My protection charm!
I get nervous if I don't have it with me.

[Ridsh]
You've been fine so far without it?!

[Dien]
...

[Ridsh]
Ah... Sorry..
Alright.

[Ridsh]
While we open the last door, would you mind going back to ^FF0000Clana Nemieri^000000?

[Ridsh]
I have to contact a few people anyway, and Dien won't go anywhere until she gets her protection charm.

[Ridsh]
Sister, tell me where it is.

[Dien]
Oh!
Thank you so much for that

[Dien]
It's hard for me to get it back because it's far...
Please do me a favor.

[Dien]
^FF0000Go back to my room and look for a chest on the left side of the window, near a vase.

[Dien]
It should be easy to get since we're here.

[Ridsh]
Oh!
Shouldn't we tell them where we are?

[Cotnes]
It's good sometimes to take a quick walk like this~

[Est]
I eager to explore the area beyond here.

[Ridsh]
I'm tired!
I want to go home.

[Dien]
It would be better to just go around the door.
